resources.string: Ctrl+Shift+D (PNG Drop) · Ctrl+Shift+C (Color Picker) · Ctrl+Shift+G (Local History)

BookTools provides three global keyboard shortcuts:

• Ctrl + Shift + D: Converts any image on the clipboard (WebP, JPEG, PNG, etc.) into a lossless PNG in Downloads and opens a frosted glass drag-and-drop popup.
• Ctrl + Shift + C: Opens a precision crosshair and zoom magnifier to click any pixel on screen and copy its #RRGGBB HEX color code to the clipboard.
• Ctrl + Shift + G: Opens your 100% local on-device Clipboard History (up to 30 text snippets, HEX colors, and PNG images) to click-to-copy or drag into any app.
